en: The image shows a reproduction of a medieval wall fresco depicting a line of soldiers with tall, rectangular shields and spears marching to the right. The figures wear conical or rounded helmets and tunics in muted reds, ochres and greens. One shield bears wave-like patterns, another shows a stylized serpent or dragon. At the far left a figure in striped armor appears to confront or command the column. The style is flat and linear, typical of Romanesque Italian fresco painting.
